$description:
Toggle contract — persistent on/off controls.

Covers standalone Toggle. ToggleGroup is always a joined segmented bar and
reads the segment contract for cell chrome; it does not use a layout variant.

Colour hooks resolve at recipe use-sites:
  --a63-toggle-background           -> transparent
  --a63-toggle-foreground           -> var(--a63-text-primary)
  --a63-toggle-hover-background     -> var(--a63-surface-control-hover)
  --a63-toggle-on-background        -> var(--a63-surface-muted)
  --a63-toggle-on-foreground        -> var(--a63-text-primary)
  --a63-toggle-primary-background   -> var(--a63-action-primary)
  --a63-toggle-primary-foreground   -> var(--a63-action-primary-foreground)
